name: Dynamic per recipient subscriptions
description: With dynamic per recipient subscriptions, you can set up a single email subscription that delivers a different copy of a report to each recipient. Using data in a Power BI dataset, you can dynamically specify who should receive the subscription and with what data. For example, consider a multi-geo sales report. You can now send this report to all salespeople, with each receiving an email with an exported copy of the report with only sales data from their region. Support for dynamic subscriptions will be extended from only paginated reports to also include Power BI reports.
